method.method_draft: Use a 3D coordinate model. From the image, identify the solid as a rectangular box with point P at the center of one square face and Q at a corner of the parallel opposite square face. From the text, take the square face side lengths as 16 cm and the thickness between the two square bases as 4 cm. Place P at the center of the near base, e.g. P = (8, 8, 0), and choose the corresponding opposite-base corner Q = (16, 16, 4). The displacement from P to Q is half a side in each square-base direction and the full thickness: 8, 8, and 4. Apply the 3D distance formula: sqrt(8^2 + 8^2 + 4^2) = sqrt(144) = 12.

method.method_draft: Use a diagonal cross-section. From the image, note that P is the center of a square base and Q is a corner of the opposite parallel base, so the projection of Q onto P's base is a corner of the square base. From the text, the square base has side 16 and the box thickness is 4. First find the distance in the square base from its center P to a corner: the square diagonal is 16sqrt(2), so half the diagonal is 8sqrt(2). Then form the right triangle whose legs are this in-base distance 8sqrt(2) and the perpendicular thickness 4, and whose hypotenuse is PQ. Thus PQ = sqrt((8sqrt(2))^2 + 4^2) = sqrt(128 + 16) = sqrt(144) = 12.

图像描述：图中是一个扁的长方体盒子，上方可见一个平行四边形形状的方形底面投影，点 P 标在这个上方底面内部；点 Q 标在与它平行的相对底面的一个角附近，位于盒子右下侧的角处。

推理：题目说明这个长方体盒子的两个方形底面都是 16 cm by 16 cm，厚度为 4 cm。按对角截面来看，Q 垂直投影到 P 所在的方形底面时，对应的是该方形底面的一个角。因此先求 P 到该方形底面一个角的距离。方形边长为 16，所以方形对角线为 16√2，中心到角的距离是半条对角线，即 8√2。再把这个平面内距离 8√2 与盒子的垂直厚度 4 作为直角三角形的两条直角边，PQ 是斜边。因此 PQ = √((8√2)^2 + 4^2) = √(128 + 16) = √144 = 12。
